trigger.title: Question about Triceps Extension (Cable) @ Gym 2
trigger.detail: My triceps extension has been stuck for weeks. What should I change?

items.question: My triceps extension has been stuck for weeks. What should I change?
items.diagnosis: Triceps extension has not improved its best e1RM for several sessions while your HRV, resting heart rate and sleep are in their normal range, so this looks like a plateau at the current rep range rather than a recovery problem. Weekly running volume is well below the 10 % cap, so there is room to build it a little.
items.notes_for_user: Nothing changes until you approve it. If triceps still stalls in 3-4 weeks, ask me again.

changes.label: Triceps Extension (Cable) rep range
changes.reason: A slightly higher floor keeps the load heavier for longer before the next load step; check the best e1RM again in 3-4 weeks.

changes.label: Weekly run volume cap (%)
changes.reason: Weekly km have stayed well under the cap for the last 4 weeks.
